description: CISM3 is the third version of the Community Ice Sheet Model used in CESM3 and as a standalone component. CISM is a state-of-the-art 3D, parallel thermomechanical model. Key physics and parameterizations include: 1. Depth-integrated higher-order solver for ice dynamics. 2. Grounding line parameterization. 3. Melt parameterization for floating ice. 4. Many basal sliding law options including: powerlaw, Wirtmann, Schoof, pseudo-plastic. 5. Vertically varying Elastic Lithosphere Relaxed Asthenosphere (ELRA) for GIA. 6. Physic-based calving laws. 7. Basal melt parameterizations. 8. Lateral melting at calving fronts. 9. Initialization process to include thickness change rates.  Items 5-9 are are notable features added since CISM2. In addition, CISM has options to simulate Alpine glaciers.
